title: sarif.json
description: The SARIF 2.1.0 log that scripts/ci.mjs writes with --sarif, as scripts/lib/sarif.mjs builds it: the subset of the format that this tool writes, not the whole format. The tests validate the logs of real scans against this schema with test/helpers/schema-check.mjs (test/sarif.test.mjs). The keys that a JSON schema cannot state are checked by test/helpers/sarif-check.mjs: the ruleIndex of a result that names its ruleId, the unique rule ids, and the note that the judgment rules were not applied. The published SARIF schema is not used or fetched; $schema is written as a string only. Unknown fields are errors (additionalProperties is false). The uri of a location is a relative reference of the target, percent-encoded by segment.

$schema.description: The SARIF schema URL, written as a string only.

runs.description: One run: the CI scan of the target.

invocations.description: The invocation of the CI run. The tool writes one.

judgmentRulesApplied.description: Always false: a CI run applies the measured rules only.

judgmentRules.description: The number of judgment rules of the catalog, which the run does not apply.

results.description: One result per measured finding, in the order of measuredFindings.

version.description: The version of the tool, from meta.tool of measurements.json.

rules.description: The measured rules of the catalog, sorted by id. The judgment rules are not listed.

executionSuccessful.description: Always true: a run that fails writes no log.

toolExecutionNotifications.description: The notes of the run. The first one says that the judgment rules were not applied.

ruleId.description: The id of a measured rule of the run.

ruleIndex.description: The place of that rule in tool.driver.rules.

level.description: A high finding is an error, a medium finding a warning and a low finding a note.

locations.description: One location per evidence entry that names a file of the target. Absent when there is none.

region.description: Present only when the evidence has a line of at least 1.

endLine.description: Present only with startLine, and not before it.

uri.description: A relative reference of the target. It has no colon (so no scheme and no drive letter) and no backslash, it does not start or end with a slash, it has no empty segment, and it has no parent folder segment. The pattern checks these; each segment is percent-encoded when the log is written.
